description: This file contains unit test classes and supporting classes for testing Orleans streaming providers, specifically focusing on Event Hub stream provider monitoring and cache pressure injection.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderForMonitorTestsAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing an Orleans Event Hub stream provider with monitoring and cache pressure injection capabilities.

classes.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class that can simulate cache pressure conditions for testing purposes.

classes.name: CacheFactoryForMonitorTesting
classes.description: A specialized cache factory used in testing that adds cache pressure monitors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the factory with dependencies from the service provider.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting up the receiver monitor factory and cache pressure monitor.

methods.name: ChangeCachePressure
methods.description: Toggles the cache pressure state for testing.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory with monitoring capabilities.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands such as retrieving monitor call counters or changing cache pressure.
